TYPE MachineStatus : STRUCT // ---- COMMAND : HMI writes ---- Power : BOOL; // is power OK Home : BOOL; // is home ManualMode : BOOL; // NOT Auto AutoMode : BOOL; // auto / manual selector
ResetRequest :BOOL; // true if reset requert StopRequest :BOOL; // ---- STATUS : PLC writes ---- SafetyOk : BOOL; // emergency + doors BusOk : BOOL; // fieldbus ready PowerOk : BOOL; // all drives powered HomeOk : BOOL; // all axes homed AxisOk : BOOL; // all axes no error Ready : BOOL; // all above + no alarm
Running : BOOL; // machine running END_STRUCT END_TYPE

(* ======================================== HMI VARIABLE LIST ========================================
--- READ --- Machine.Ready Machine.Running Machine.SafetyOk Machine.PowerOk Machine.HomeOk
Alarms.Active Alarms.Count Alarms.ActiveList[1..20]
Clock.Act.wDay Clock.Act.wMonth Clock.Act.wYear Clock.Act.wHour Clock.Act.wMinute Clock.Act.wSecond
--- WRITE --- Machine.Auto Machine.Power Machine.Home
Clock.Set.wDay Clock.Set.wMonth Clock.Set.wYear Clock.Set.wHour Clock.Set.wMinute Clock.Set.wSecond
TimeRead // button "Load" TimeWrite // button "Apply"
======================================== TIME CHANGE ======================================== 1. press "Load" -> Clock.Set = Clock.Act 2. edit Clock.Set fields 3. press "Apply" -> written to RTC
*)
TYPE hmi_table : STRUCT
END_STRUCT END_TYPE
